name: パステルドリーム
css: body { overflow: hidden !important; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF5F8 0%, #F0F8FF 50%, #FFFEF5 100%); }

.roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFFFF, #FEFAFF); border-radius: 50%; padding: 15px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(200, 180, 230, 0.25), 0 0 0 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9), 0 0 0 10px rgba(230, 210, 250, 0.3); margin: 0 !important; }
#roulette-svg-target { border-radius: 50%; }
.gradient-circle { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; z-index: 3; opacity: 0.15; pointer-events: none; animation: circleFloat 15s ease-in-out infinite; }
.circle1 { width: 200px; height: 200px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #FFD4E5, transparent); top: 50px; left: 100px; animation-delay: 0s; }
.circle2 { width: 250px; height: 250px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #D4E5FF, transparent); bottom: 80px; right: 80px; animation-delay: -5s; }
.circle3 { width: 180px; height: 180px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #FFF4D4, transparent); top: 200px; right: 150px; animation-delay: -10s; }
@keyframes circleFloat { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translate(20px, -20px) scale(1.1); } }
.floating-shape { position: absolute; font-size: 32px; z-index: 4; opacity: 0.3; pointer-events: none; animation: shapeFloat 12s ease-in-out infinite; }
.shape1 { top: 100px; left: 200px; color: #FFB8D4; animation-delay: 0s; }
.shape2 { top: 180px; right: 150px; color: #B8D4FF; animation-delay: -3s; }
.shape3 { bottom: 150px; left: 150px; color: #FFE8B8; animation-delay: -6s; }
.shape4 { bottom: 120px; right: 200px; color: #D4B8FF; animation-delay: -9s; }
@keyframes shapeFloat { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0.3; } 50% { transform: translateY(-25px) rotate(180deg); opacity: 0.6; } }
.pointer { position: absolute; top: 18px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 25; }

.pointer::before { content: '▼'; font-size: 40px; color: #FF8EC7; display: block; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 10px rgba(255, 142, 199, 0.5)) drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(255, 142, 199, 0.7)); animation: pointerPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }

@keyframes pointerPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 10px rgba(255, 142, 199, 0.5)) drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(255, 142, 199, 0.7)); } 50% { transform: scale(1.1); filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 10px rgba(255, 142, 199, 0.7)) drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(255, 142, 199, 1)); } }

.center-circle { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 70px; height: 70px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #FFFFFF, #FFF5FB); border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #FFB8D4; box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(255, 184, 212, 0.35), inset 0 2px 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); z-index: 30; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.center-icon { font-size: 24px; color: #FF8EC7; animation: iconSpin 3s linear infinite; }
@keyframes iconSpin { 0% { transform: rotate(0deg); } 100% { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

#spinBtn { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 220px; height: 65px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #FF6BAD; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFFFF, #FFF8FC); border: 3px solid #FFB8D4; border-radius: 50px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(255, 184, 212, 0.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); transition: all 0.3s; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; position: absolute; top: 570px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
#spinBtn::before { content: '♦'; position: absolute; left: 18px; color: #FFB8D4; font-size: 18px; animation: btnIconShine 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
#spinBtn::after { content: '♦'; position: absolute; right: 18px; color: #FFB8D4; font-size: 18px; animation: btnIconShine 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes btnIconShine { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

#spinBtn:hover { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(255, 184, 212, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFFFF, #FFE8F5); }
#spinBtn:active { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 184, 212, 0.3); }

#result { font-size: 46px; font-weight: bold; color: #FF6BAD; text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 107, 173, 0.6), 0 3px 10px rgba(255, 107, 173, 0.4), 0 0 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 1), 2px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9), -2px -2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9), 2px -2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9), -2px 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; position: absolute; top: 680px; width: 100%; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 4px; }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) !important; border: 3px solid #FFB8D4 !important; border-radius: 15px !important; color: #FF6BAD !important; padding: 12px !important; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(255, 184, 212, 0.3) !important; }

text.filter: drop-shadow(0px 1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)) drop-shadow(0px -1px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)) drop-shadow(1px 0px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)) drop-shadow(-1px 0px 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8))
